One of the most notable Naqi's is Imam Ali al-Hadi, the 10th Imam of Shia Muslims, who was known as "He Whom Allah Has Purified." Additionally, the title Buzurg-e-Umara, which means 'Elder of the Faithful', is another title given to some Naqi's in recognition of their spiritual authority. The name Naqi is a reminder of the importance of striving for spiritual growth and self-improvement, and the role of spiritual leadership in guiding individuals towards a closer relationship with the Divine. Through the actions and teachings of a Naqi, individuals can work to purify their souls, seeking the path to truth and righteousness.
